text:
Diego Vega: Hey everyone — Diego here! I started today as an Infrastructure Engineer on the Platform team. Super excited to join Redwood 🎉 I'm based in PST, prefer async, and my first week's goals are to get my dev laptop set up, join the right Slack channels, and shadow a serving-run. Quick q's: 1) Has my MacBook shipped? 2) Who do I ping for MDM/enrollment and VPN access? 3) Any must-join recurring meetings for new infra folks? Also, fun fact: I make small-batch hot sauce and bike fixed-gear on weekends. :hot_pepper: :bike:

Emily (People Ops): welcome Diego!! 🙌 Laptop should be on the way — I filed the equipment request this morning. I also scheduled the new hire orientation for Friday at 10am PT. You'll be auto-added to #new-hires and the company handbook link is here: <https://intranet.redwood.com/onboarding|Onboarding Hub>. For MDM + VPN, @Sarah D. from DevEx will help you enroll. If anything urgent, ping me or reply here and I'll escalate.

Sam W.: Hey Diego — thrilled to have you on the Platform team. I'll set up a 30m intro 1:1 for tomorrow. Typical rituals: Tuesday standup @ 10:30 PT, Platform sync Thu @ 11. No need to join everything this week — focus on setup and docs. I'll add you to the platform calendar and the "platform-engineering" GitHub team.

Sarah D.: @Diego Vega welcome! For MDM, follow these steps: 1) Wait for the laptop delivery, power on and connect to Wi-Fi. 2) Open the Enrollment link we send via email (it'll be from "Device Enrollment"). 3) Install the Company Profile and restart. If you prefer CLI, we have a short checklist: ```1) brew install redwood-dev-tools 2) rwd login 3) rwd enroll``` Ping me if the device doesn't show up or you hit a permissions prompt.

Ravi K.: Added you to the platform workspace on GitHub and the internal docs. You'll get invites to #platform and #infra-ops in a few minutes. For badge/building access, @Emily (People Ops) — can you confirm his office badge status? Diego — if you need early access to any datasets or KMS-encrypted buckets, tell me what you need and I'll request temporary privileges.

onboarding-bot: Equipment ticket created: TICKET-12345. ETA for delivery: 3 business days. Orientation event added to calendar: "New Hire Orientation — Fri 10:00 PT". Helpful links: Handbook, Benefits, IT Support.

Diego Vega: Awesome — thanks all! I've got the calendar invite and will wait for the laptop. I'll try the CLI steps once the device arrives. Looking forward to meeting y'all — ping me if you want to grab a quick 1:1 or a virtual coffee. Also open to taco recs in SF. :taco:

Sam W.: virtual coffee — yes please. I owe you a tour of our infra playbooks. :coffee:

Emily (People Ops): welcome aboard again! :tada:

Sarah D.: If the enrollment flow fails, DM me and I'll remote into a quick session. :thumbsup:

Ravi K.: Welcome Diego! :wave:
